utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 8:00 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 8:00 works for me too. I’ll be ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing—if we miss one pickup, the whole route could get messy. Can we confirm the exact stops and when we’re leaving?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, let’s confirm it before we go—what stops are on the route, and what time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should start at my place, then yours, then Sam’s, and leave by 7:15 so we have a little buffer.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Oren — carpool’s still on, right? I might’ve missed if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — yes, the carpool’s still on. Thanks for checking; I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, see you there — thanks!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do the carpool. I’ll swing by and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, thanks Vik — that’ll help a lot. I’ll pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll swing by and let everyone know the plan. I’ll keep it simple and make sure folks are in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we’re leaving at 7:30, and I’ve got room for two if you still need a ride.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’m in—thanks, Gus. I’ll be ready by 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the carpool. Let’s keep it simple—what day and pickup time are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks, Eli! Let’s aim for Thursday at 7:30 AM, and I’ll send the exact pickup details once I confirm the route.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7:30 AM works for me. Send me the pickup details when you’ve got them, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I’m still on for it this morning. I’ll be ready at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help keep the carpool organized. Who’s riding with who this time?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the pickup list here — I’ll sort the riders and send you the route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks — send it my way when you’re ready and I’ll help keep everyone on track.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that’s so kind. I’m thinking weekday mornings around 7:30 and pickup around 3:15, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that should work for me most weekdays. Let’s plan for 7:30 in the mornings and 3:15 for pickup, and we can adjust if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list if you want, and I’ll note who’s in for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks — just let me know who’s in for carpool.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll check in with everyone and let you know who’s in for carpool.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — I can help keep the carpool straight. Who’s riding with who this week?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’m still figuring it out, but I can send you the names I have and we can sort it together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — send me the names whenever you’re ready, and I’ll help sort the pairs out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and addresses so I can double-check everything?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — pickup is at 3:15, and the stops are 124 Maple, then 88 Oak, and finally the school.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got 3:15 and the stops are 124 Maple, 88 Oak, then the school. I’ll double-check the route and timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the pickup time and address.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll text you the pickup time and address as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do the carpool and I’ll remind everyone about the plan. Just let me know the time and pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, thanks Vik — let’s do 7:30 at the corner by the park. I’ll send the full pickup list now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — 7:30 at the corner by the park works for me, and I’ll remind everyone on the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, carpool—right. What time were we doing it again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think we said around 8:15, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 8:15 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — I could use help on Tuesdays and Thursdays if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can cover Tuesdays and Thursdays.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m glad we’re coordinating the carpool. What time works best for you, and how many seats do we need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m good with 8:15, and I can take 3 seats total.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — 8:15 works, and I’ve got you down for 3 seats. I’ll share the plan with everyone and make sure the pickup is set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing—what time are we leaving, and how many people are we fitting in?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re leaving at 8:15, and I can fit four people total. I’ll send the details to everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps—8:15 should work if everyone’s ready on time. Can you also confirm who’s bringing the extra seat?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, can you confirm the carpool time and pickup spot again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — can you remind me of the time and pickup spot you have, and I’ll confirm it carefully?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I have 7:30 at the corner by the mailbox — can you confirm that’s right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Dane. Let’s keep it simple—just tell me the pickup time and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — could you swing by around 7:15 at my place? I’m right by the corner on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — 7:15 at your place by Maple works for me. I’ll be there right on time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — I heard the carpool was still on, but I only got that secondhand. Is there anything I should know before I show up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, it’s still on — just be there a few minutes early so we can sort out who’s riding with whom.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks — I’ll come a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the carpool. I’m happy to help, just remind me what time you wanted me there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — could you be there by 7:15 tomorrow morning? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 7:15 tomorrow morning works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — what time do you need the carpool to pick up the kids?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Around 7:30 would be great, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7:30 works for me — I’ll plan on that.
